verdict.rationale: Abacum documents scenarios (base, bull and bear) built from a shared base version with changeable assumptions, all held in a governed workspace. Separately, it claims a detailed history of every edit event on data models, spaces and dimension mappings. These together suggest an auditable trail, but the docs never tie the edit history to scenario assumptions or say that it records who made each change. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption logging, documented user attribution of changes, an audit view for comparing scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
